limit80.subject: You’ve used 80% of this month’s WhatsApp replies
limit80.used: Your automatic WhatsApp replies have used {used} of {limit} for this month.
limit80.nothingStopped: Nothing has stopped. When you reach {limit}, automatic replies pause until your allowance resets on {reset} — customers can still message you, and you’ll still see everything they send.
limit80.raise: You can raise your monthly limit in Settings whenever you like.
limit80.raiseLink: You can raise your monthly limit in Settings whenever you like:

limit100.subject: Your WhatsApp auto-replies have paused for this month
limit100.usedAll: You’ve used all {limit} of this month’s automatic WhatsApp replies, so they’ve paused.
limit100.stillReach: Customers can still message you as normal, and every message still reaches you. The only thing that’s stopped is the automatic reply going back out.
limit100.startAgain: They’ll start again on {reset}, or straight away if you raise your monthly limit in Settings.
limit100.startAgainLink: They’ll start again on {reset}, or straight away if you raise your monthly limit in Settings:

paymentBlocked.subject: WhatsApp needs a payment method before it can send
paymentBlocked.stopped: WhatsApp has stopped your automatic replies going out because there’s no working payment method on your WhatsApp Business account.
paymentBlocked.stillMessage: Customers can still message you, and you’ll still see everything they send — but the replies aren’t reaching them.
paymentBlocked.payDirect: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager rather than in HatchGrab. Add or update a card there and replies start again on their own.
